# SOSAO LLC

Digital yoga & wellness programs store — open online 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Offerings
- 3 membership plans: Starter $19/month, Professional $49/month, Premium $99/month
- 37 one-time digital yoga programs, $10 to $999
- Digital products only: instant access after purchase, no physical shipping
